Committed as `0beb371`. **What I built:** - `src/validate.js` — `validate({ email, password })` returns the exact per-field messages from the brief (missing/blank email, invalid email, missing password, short password) or `{}` when valid. - `src/form.js` — `render({ values, errors, submitting })` now renders labeled/escaped inputs, per-field `aria-invalid`/`aria-describedby` + `

` right after the input, an `

` summary (with links to each field) preceding the fields when errors exist, and a submitting state (`aria-busy="true"`, disabled button, "Signing up…" text). **Verification:** Wrote tests first (TDD) for both the validator and each rendered state, confirmed they failed against the original stubs, then implemented until all 18 tests pass (`node --test`). No UI to run in a browser here since this is server-side HTML string rendering with no dev server — verified via the test suite and by manually inspecting the rendered output for the empty state, which matches `index.html`'s static preview.
